rv.q: That the edgy New Group's artistic director Scott Elliott would be attracted to this bit of foolish, improbable and grievously dated fluff is in itself curious.
With strong performances, thoughtful direction and impressive attention to detail from the creative team, “Barefoot in the Park” makes for a delightful night of theatre.

cn.t: Critics are split on this Neil Simon revival — one finds charm in the classic romantic comedy, while another says the laughs that made the 1963 original a mega-hit fail to land in this production.
